notes: Growth insights UI batch (no migration). (1) GSC commercial-intent tagging plus a striking-distance view: query terms are labelled sourcing / OEM / bulk from a single shared keyword source (industry-neutral; unmatched terms stay commercial:false and are never dropped), and a new 'striking distance' view lists commercial-intent queries whose impression-weighted average position is 4-20 (page-bottom 4-10 / page-two 11-20), ranked by impressions / position. Both run entirely in the read layer over the existing gsc_search_terms fact table (028), so there is no schema change. (2) /growth split cards (query/page/country/device) are now localized to Chinese via labels.ts and show values in full instead of truncating long URLs/queries. (3) GA4 section title renamed to 'GA4 事件观察' with a ? tooltip carrying the path/evidence caveats; the funnel block gained a '表单漏斗与趋势' heading whose ? tooltip carries the independent-evidence caveats (both paragraphs removed from the visible body). (4) Keyword trends is embedded into the growth insights page (/growth, anchored at #keyword-trends) via a reusable GrowthTermsSection server component; the /growth/terms route is kept for direct access and synthetic browser verification but is no longer linked from the UI. No new SQL migration: the previous image reads the same schema, so a rollback to v0.2.12 keeps running.
